groups.defect: The membership endpoints require :group_id while their routes supply :id.
groups.rationale: All three report the same parameter-contract mismatch affecting both add_members and remove_member. Differences in predicted HTTP status and proposed fixes do not distinguish the defect.

groups.defect: totalPages overcounts by one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit, allowing an empty trailing page.
groups.rationale: Every suggestion identifies the same floor-plus-one calculation and its pagination consequences.

groups.defect: findMembers returns undefined instead of a promise when the group name is empty.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same bare return and the resulting break in the method's promise contract.
